question: In an examination, Aarti scored twice that of Sheela. Sheela got more marks than Chinta. Chinta scored less than Taran. Taran scored less than Ila. Ila scored less than Sheela but higher than Chinta. Who among the following got more marks than Ila?
solution:
given:- 

Aarti scored twice the score of Sheela.

Sheela got more marks than worry.

Chinta scored less than Taran. Taran scored less than Ila.

Ila scored less than Sheela but higher than Anxiety

From the following information, given below will be the order of their ranking. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1fa44774847f71c3b7dfb445e654f2ab7a62ad9a8f788a919a8e6db3a6947f.png] 

Hence, Arti and Sheela have scored more marks than Ila.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3)
